name: Keto Braised Beef Short Ribs
evidence: No short-rib or keto whole-muscle braise exists in the 138-recipe beef catalog; every catalog braise is beef-chuck-roast or sirloin served over a starch base (rice/potato/noodle bowls). The nearest red-wine braise, beef-bourguignon-bowls, is a distinct dish (bacon, mushrooms, carrots, flour, starch-bowl format) versus this bare aromatics + broth + wine + rosemary short-rib braise with no starch base and a different cut (bone-in short ribs). 412 cal / 1.5g carbs clears the 400-650 cal and <=35g carb band.
notes: Calories sit near the 400 floor (412) with a fatty profile (25g fat) -- watch the recompute/repricing so the label-accurate short-rib rows keep it in band. Carries wanted unmapped picks (bone-in-beef-short-ribs, red-wine, avocado-oil, fresh-rosemary) for the pricer lane.
cross_protein_collision_watch: A pork or lamb red-wine/rosemary whole-muscle braise (e.g. braised pork shoulder / lamb shanks in red wine) would be structurally the same dish -- a bare-aromatic wine braise of a fatty cut with no starch base -- differing only in protein; flag if such a candidate exists in the pork/lamb pools.
Any other 'braised beef in red wine' candidate in a parallel beef selector's pool could twin this if it likewise omits the vegetable garnish and starch base.
